passages.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. A song.
passages.sermon:
This is a psalm.
David wrote this psalm.
This psalm is a song.
The choirmaster leads this song.

passages.text: God arises. His enemies are scattered, and those who hate Him flee His presence.
passages.sermon:
This is a psalm of David.
David wrote this song for the choirmaster.
God stands up.
God’s enemies scatter.
Those who hate God run away from Him.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ לְדָוִ֗ד מִזְמ֥וֹר שִֽׁיר׃ יָק֣וּם אֱ֭לֹהִים יָפ֣וּצוּ אוֹיְבָ֑יו וְיָנ֥וּסוּ מְ֝שַׂנְאָ֗יו מִפָּנָֽיו׃

passages.text: As smoke is blown away, You will drive them out; as wax melts before the fire, the wicked will perish in the presence of God.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful and holy.
God removes the wicked from His presence.
Smoke disappears when the wind blows it away.
God drives out the wicked just as wind drives away smoke.
Wax melts when it is near fire.
The wicked perish before God just as wax melts before fire.
passages.original: כְּהִנְדֹּ֥ף עָשָׁ֗ן תִּ֫נְדֹּ֥ף כְּהִמֵּ֣ס דּ֭וֹנַג מִפְּנֵי־ אֵ֑שׁ יֹאבְד֥וּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים מִפְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: But the righteous will be glad and rejoice before God; they will celebrate with joy.
passages.sermon:
The righteous are people who do what is right in God's eyes.
God is holy and powerful.
The righteous will be glad.
They will rejoice before God.
They will celebrate with joy.
passages.original: וְֽצַדִּיקִ֗ים יִשְׂמְח֣וּ יַֽ֭עַלְצוּ לִפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִ֗ים וְיָשִׂ֥ישׂוּ בְשִׂמְחָֽה׃

passages.text: Sing to God! Sing praises to His name. Exalt Him who rides on the clouds — His name is the LORD— and rejoice before Him.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
He rides on the clouds.
Sing to God.
Sing praises to His name.
Exalt Him.
Rejoice before Him.
passages.original: שִׁ֤ירוּ׀ לֵֽאלֹהִים֮ זַמְּר֪וּ שְׁ֫מ֥וֹ סֹ֡לּוּ לָרֹכֵ֣ב בָּ֭עֲרָבוֹת בְּיָ֥הּ שְׁמ֗וֹ וְעִלְז֥וּ לְפָנָֽיו׃

passages.text: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in His holy habitation.
passages.sermon: God lives in His holy dwelling place.\r\nGod is a father to orphans.\r\nGod defends widows.
passages.original: אֲבִ֣י יְ֭תוֹמִים וְדַיַּ֣ן אַלְמָנ֑וֹת אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בִּמְע֥וֹן קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃

passages.text: God settles the lonely in families; He leads the prisoners out to prosperity, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
passages.sermon:
God acts with compassion and power.
God places lonely people in families.
God brings prisoners out into prosperity.
Rebellious people live in a dry, sun-scorched land.
passages.original: אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ מ֘וֹשִׁ֤יב יְחִידִ֨ים׀ בַּ֗יְתָה מוֹצִ֣יא אֲ֭סִירִים בַּכּוֹשָׁר֑וֹת אַ֥ךְ ס֝וֹרֲרִ֗ים שָׁכְנ֥וּ צְחִיחָֽה׃

passages.text: O God, when You went out before Your people, when You marched through the wasteland, Selah the earth shook and the heavens poured down rain before God, the One on Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.
passages.sermon:
God is the God of Israel.
God went out before His people.
God marched through the wasteland.
The earth shook before God.
The heavens poured down rain before God.
God is the One on Sinai.
God led His people with power.
passages.original: אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים בְּ֭צֵאתְךָ לִפְנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּצַעְדְּךָ֖ בִֽישִׁימ֣וֹן סֶֽלָה׃ אֶ֤רֶץ רָעָ֨שָׁה׀ אַף־ שָׁמַ֣יִם נָטְפוּ֮ מִפְּנֵ֪י אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים זֶ֥ה סִינַ֑י מִפְּנֵ֥י אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: You sent abundant rain, O God; You refreshed Your weary inheritance.
passages.sermon:
God sent abundant rain.
God gave this rain freely.
God’s people were tired.
God refreshed His weary people.
God cared for His inheritance.
passages.original: גֶּ֣שֶׁם נְ֭דָבוֹת תָּנִ֣יף אֱלֹהִ֑ים נַחֲלָתְךָ֥ וְ֝נִלְאָ֗ה אַתָּ֥ה כֽוֹנַנְתָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: Your flock settled therein; O God, from Your bounty You provided for the poor.
passages.sermon:
God cares for His people.
God’s people are like a flock.
God’s flock settled in the land.
God gave good things to the poor.
God provided for the poor from His bounty.
passages.original: חַיָּתְךָ֥ יָֽשְׁבוּ־ בָ֑הּ תָּ֤כִ֥ין בְּטוֹבָתְךָ֖ לֶעָנִ֣י אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: The Lord gives the command; a great company of women proclaim it: “Kings and their armies flee in haste; she who waits at home divides the plunder.
passages.sermon:
The Lord gives a command.
Many women announce this message.
Kings and their armies run away quickly.
The woman who stays at home shares the plunder.
passages.original: אֲדֹנָ֥י יִתֶּן־ אֹ֑מֶר הַֽ֝מְבַשְּׂר֗וֹת צָבָ֥א רָֽב׃ מַלְכֵ֣י צְ֭בָאוֹת יִדֹּד֣וּן יִדֹּד֑וּן וּנְוַת בַּ֝֗יִת תְּחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁלָֽל׃

passages.text: Though you lie down among the sheepfolds, the wings of the dove are covered with silver, and her feathers with shimmering gold.”
passages.sermon:
God cares for His people.
Some people rest among the sheepfolds.
A dove spreads its wings.
The dove’s wings shine with silver.
The dove’s feathers gleam with yellow gold.
passages.original: אִֽם־ תִּשְׁכְּבוּן֮ בֵּ֪ין שְׁפַ֫תָּ֥יִם כַּנְפֵ֣י י֭וֹנָה נֶחְפָּ֣ה בַכֶּ֑סֶף וְ֝אֶבְרוֹתֶ֗יהָ בִּֽירַקְרַ֥ק חָרֽוּץ׃

passages.text: When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like the snow falling on Zalmon.
passages.sermon: The Almighty is God.\r\nGod scattered the kings in the land.\r\nThis event was like snow falling on Zalmon.
passages.original: בְּפָ֘רֵ֤שׂ שַׁדַּ֓י מְלָ֘כִ֤ים בָּ֗הּ תַּשְׁלֵ֥ג בְּצַלְמֽוֹן׃

passages.text: A mountain of God is Mount Bashan; a mountain of many peaks is Mount Bashan.
passages.sermon: Mount Bashan is a mountain of God.\r\nMount Bashan has many peaks.\r\nMount Bashan stands as a mountain of God.
passages.original: הַר־ אֱ֭לֹהִים הַר־ בָּשָׁ֑ן הַ֥ר גַּ֝בְנֻנִּ֗ים הַר־ בָּשָֽׁן׃

passages.text: Why do you gaze in envy, O mountains of many peaks? This is the mountain God chose for His dwelling, where the LORD will surely dwell forever.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God chose a mountain for His dwelling place.
This mountain is not one of the many-peaked mountains.
Many-peaked mountains look at this chosen mountain with envy.
God desired to live on this mountain.
The LORD will live there forever.
passages.original: לָ֤מָּה׀ תְּֽרַצְּדוּן֮ הָרִ֪ים גַּבְנֻ֫נִּ֥ים הָהָ֗ר חָמַ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְשִׁבְתּ֑וֹ אַף־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָנֶֽצַח׃

passages.text: The chariots of God are tens of thousands— thousands of thousands are they; the Lord is in His sanctuary as He was at Sinai.
passages.sermon:
God has many chariots.
God’s chariots number tens of thousands.
God’s chariots number thousands upon thousands.
The Lord is among them.
The Lord is present in His holy place.
The Lord was present at Sinai.
The Lord is present in His sanctuary now.
passages.original: רֶ֤כֶב אֱלֹהִ֗ים רִבֹּתַ֣יִם אַלְפֵ֣י שִׁנְאָ֑ן אֲדֹנָ֥י בָ֝֗ם סִינַ֥י בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: You have ascended on high; You have led captives away. You have received gifts from men, even from the rebellious, that the LORD God may dwell there.
passages.sermon:
God is the subject.
God ascended on high.
God led captives away.
God received gifts from people.
Even rebellious people gave gifts.
God did this so the LORD God may dwell there.
passages.original: עָ֘לִ֤יתָ לַמָּר֨וֹם׀ שָׁ֘בִ֤יתָ שֶּׁ֗בִי לָקַ֣חְתָּ מַ֭תָּנוֹת בָּאָדָ֑ם וְאַ֥ף ס֝וֹרְרִ֗ים לִשְׁכֹּ֤ן׀ יָ֬הּ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden, the God of our salvation. Selah Our God is a God of deliverance; the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death.
passages.sermon:
The Lord is God.
The Lord is our God.
The Lord is the God who saves us.
The Lord carries our burdens every day.
The Lord is blessed.
Our God rescues us.
The Lord GOD saves us from death.
passages.original: בָּ֤ר֣וּךְ אֲדֹנָי֮ י֤וֹם׀ י֥וֹם יַֽעֲמָס־ לָ֗נוּ הָ֘אֵ֤ל יְֽשׁוּעָתֵ֬נוּ סֶֽלָה׃ הָ֤אֵ֣ל׀ לָנוּ֮ אֵ֤ל לְֽמוֹשָׁ֫ע֥וֹת וְלֵיהוִ֥ה אֲדֹנָ֑י לַ֝מָּ֗וֶת תּוֹצָאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Surely God will crush the heads of His enemies, the hairy crowns of those who persist in guilty ways.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful.
God has enemies.
God will crush the heads of His enemies.
Some enemies have hairy crowns.
These enemies continue in their guilt.
God will destroy those who persist in guilty ways.
passages.original: אַךְ־ אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִמְחַץ֮ רֹ֤אשׁ אֹ֫יְבָ֥יו קָדְקֹ֥ד שֵׂעָ֑ר מִ֝תְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בַּאֲשָׁמָֽיו׃

passages.text: The Lord said, “I will retrieve them from Bashan, I will bring them up from the depths of the sea, that your foot may be dipped in the blood of your foes— the tongues of your dogs in the same.”
passages.sermon:
The Lord is God.
The Lord speaks with authority.
The Lord says, “I will bring them back from Bashan.
I will bring them up from the depths of the sea.
I will do this so that your foot will tread in the blood of your enemies.
Your dogs will lick the blood of your enemies.”
passages.original: אָמַ֣ר אֲ֭דֹנָי מִבָּשָׁ֣ן אָשִׁ֑יב אָ֝שִׁ֗יב מִֽמְּצֻל֥וֹת יָֽם׃ לְמַ֤עַן׀ תִּֽמְחַ֥ץ רַגְלְךָ֗ בְּ֫דָ֥ם לְשׁ֥וֹן כְּלָבֶ֑יךָ מֵאֹיְבִ֥ים מִנֵּֽהוּ׃

passages.text: They have seen Your procession, O God— the march of my God and King into the sanctuary.
passages.sermon:
God is my God and King.
God enters the sanctuary.
People see God's procession.
People see God march into the holy place.
passages.original: רָא֣וּ הֲלִיכוֹתֶ֣יךָ אֱלֹהִ֑ים הֲלִ֘יכ֤וֹת אֵלִ֖י מַלְכִּ֣י בַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: The singers lead the way, the musicians follow after, among the maidens playing tambourines.
passages.sermon: Singers go first.\r\nMusicians come after them.\r\nYoung women play tambourines among them.
passages.original: קִדְּמ֣וּ שָׁ֭רִים אַחַ֣ר נֹגְנִ֑ים בְּת֥וֹךְ עֲ֝לָמ֗וֹת תּוֹפֵפֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Bless God in the great congregation; bless the LORD from the fountain of Israel.
passages.sermon:
The people gather together in a great assembly.
They bless God there.
They bless the LORD.
They come from the fountain of Israel.
The congregation praises God as the source of Israel.
passages.original: בְּֽ֭מַקְהֵלוֹת בָּרְכ֣וּ אֱלֹהִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִמְּק֥וֹר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them, the princes of Judah in their company, the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.
passages.sermon:
Benjamin is there.
Benjamin is the youngest tribe.
Benjamin rules over them.
The princes of Judah are with them.
The princes of Zebulun are there.
The princes of Naphtali are there.
passages.original: שָׁ֤ם בִּנְיָמִ֨ן׀ צָעִ֡יר רֹדֵ֗ם שָׂרֵ֣י יְ֭הוּדָה רִגְמָתָ֑ם שָׂרֵ֥י זְ֝בֻל֗וּן שָׂרֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִֽי׃

passages.text: Summon Your power, O God; show Your strength, O God, which You have exerted on our behalf.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful.
God has shown His strength to us.
God, summon Your power.
God, show Your strength again.
You have acted with strength for us before.
passages.original: צִוָּ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ עֻ֫זֶּ֥ךָ עוּזָּ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים ז֝֗וּ פָּעַ֥לְתָּ לָּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: Because of Your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring You gifts.
passages.sermon:
God has a temple in Jerusalem.
Kings see this temple.
Kings bring gifts to God because of His temple.
Kings honor God with their gifts.
passages.original: מֵֽ֭הֵיכָלֶךָ עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְךָ֤ יוֹבִ֖ילוּ מְלָכִ֣ים שָֽׁי׃

passages.text: Rebuke the beast in the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations, until it submits, bringing bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.
passages.sermon:
God, rebuke the beast in the reeds.
This beast is strong and dangerous.
It is like a herd of bulls among the calves of the nations.
The beast submits when it brings bars of silver.
God, scatter the nations who delight in war.
These nations love conflict and fighting.
God acts with power against those who seek war.
passages.original: גְּעַ֨ר חַיַּ֪ת קָנֶ֡ה עֲדַ֤ת אַבִּירִ֨ים׀ בְּעֶגְלֵ֬י עַמִּ֗ים מִתְרַפֵּ֥ס בְּרַצֵּי־ כָ֑סֶף בִּזַּ֥ר עַ֝מִּ֗ים קְרָב֥וֹת יֶחְפָּֽצוּ׃

passages.text: Envoys will arrive from Egypt; Cush will stretch out her hands to God.
passages.sermon: Envoys will come from Egypt.\r\nCush will reach out her hands to God.
passages.original: יֶאֱתָ֣יוּ חַ֭שְׁמַנִּים מִנִּ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם כּ֥וּשׁ תָּרִ֥יץ יָ֝דָ֗יו לֵאלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth; sing praises to the Lord— Selah to Him who rides upon the highest heavens of old; behold, His mighty voice resounds.
passages.sermon:
All kingdoms of the earth, sing to God.
Sing praises to the Lord.
Pause and reflect.
God rides on the highest heavens.
These heavens are ancient.
God gives a mighty voice.
His voice resounds with power.
passages.original: מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ֭אָרֶץ שִׁ֣ירוּ לֵאלֹהִ֑ים זַמְּר֖וּ אֲדֹנָ֣י סֶֽלָה׃ לָ֭רֹכֵב בִּשְׁמֵ֣י שְׁמֵי־ קֶ֑דֶם הֵ֥ן יִתֵּ֥ן בְּ֝קוֹלוֹ ק֣וֹל עֹֽז׃

passages.text: Ascribe the power to God, whose majesty is over Israel, whose strength is in the skies.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful.
God rules over Israel.
God is majestic.
God’s strength fills the skies.
Give God the honor for His power.
passages.original: תְּנ֥וּ עֹ֗ז לֵֽאלֹ֫הִ֥ים עַֽל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל גַּאֲוָת֑וֹ וְ֝עֻזּ֗וֹ בַּשְּׁחָקִֽים׃

passages.text: O God, You are awesome in Your sanctuary; the God of Israel Himself gives strength and power to His people. Blessed be God!
passages.sermon:
God is awesome in His sanctuary.
God is the God of Israel.
God gives strength to His people.
God gives power to His people.
Blessed is God.
passages.original: נ֤וֹרָ֥א אֱלֹהִ֗ים מִֽמִּקְדָּ֫שֶׁ֥יךָ אֵ֤ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל ה֤וּא נֹתֵ֨ן׀ עֹ֖ז וְתַעֲצֻמ֥וֹת לָעָ֗ם בָּר֥וּךְ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
